description: Use supplementary pages SA103S to record self-employment income on your SA100 tax return if your annual business turnover was below the VAT threshold for the tax year.

details.body:
If you’re self employed, have relatively simple tax affairs and your annual business turnover was below the VAT threshold for the tax year, use the SA103S short version of the self-employment supplementary pages when filing your SA100 tax return.

Related forms and guidance

Limit on Income Tax reliefs (Self Assessment helpsheet HS204)

More than one business (Self Assessment helpsheet HS220)

How to calculate your taxable profits (Self Assessment helpsheet HS222)

Check reliefs and rules for farmers and market gardeners (Self Assessment helpsheet HS224)

Relief for trading losses (Self Assessment helpsheet HS227)

Information from your accounts (Self Assessment helpsheet HS229)

Farm stock valuation (Self Assessment helpsheet HS232)

Averaging for creators of literary or artistic works (Self Assessment helpsheet HS234)

Qualifying care relief for carers (Self Assessment helpsheet HS236)

Capital allowances and balancing charges (Self Assessment helpsheet HS252)
